## Overview

 

This document defines the machine-readable data dictionary and datasets register for the **RailActive** project and application.

 

The register standardizes data structures, variable names, units, and licensing across active datasets (North-South Corridor, custom GPX re-alignments, OS OpenRoads, DfT STATS19 road safety, OpenStreetMap active travel infrastructure, and the National Cycle Network), while tracking dependencies for forthcoming datasets (trip attractors, LCWIPs, OSMRN/PSGA, and OS NGD pavements).

 

Underlying schemas are version-controlled and available for download:

 

- [`data/datasets_overview.csv`](data/datasets_overview.csv): High-level dataset catalog and status

- [`data/data_dictionary.csv`](data/data_dictionary.csv): Full variable schema and technical definitions

- [`data/data_dictionary.json`](data/data_dictionary.json): Web-ready JSON format consumed by the frontend

 

---

## Datasets Overview Register

 

The table below summarizes all primary datasets evaluated for the RailActive corridor and economic appraisal.

 

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(DT)

overview <- read_csv("data/datasets_overview.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

overview_display <- overview |>
  select(
    `Dataset ID` = dataset_id,
    `Dataset Name` = dataset_name,
    `Status` = status,
    `Format` = format,
    `Source Agency` = source_agency,
    `Licence / Open Status` = open_status,
    `Coverage` = coverage
  )

knitr::kable(overview_display, caption = "Table 1: RailActive Dataset Inventory & Current Implementation Status")
```

## Detailed Variable Dictionaries by Dataset

 

### North-South Active Travel Corridor (v1 / v2)

 

The central spinal active travel corridor running along the HS2 civil engineering alignment from London through the Midlands to Liverpool and Manchester, incorporating regional arterial links.

 

```{r}
dict <- read_csv("data/data_dictionary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

corridor_vars <- dict |>
  filter(dataset_id == "north_south_corridor") |>
  select(`Variable` = variable_name, `Type` = data_type, `Description` = description, `Values / Units` = allowed_values_or_units, `Notes` = notes)

knitr::kable(corridor_vars, caption = "Table 2: North-South Active Travel Corridor Variable Dictionary")
```

 

### Custom Re-alignments (Shane Snow GPX)

 

Granular re-alignments digitised from client GPX tracks to bypass dangerous road sections (e.g. Swanley Lane rat run, Crawley gyratory) and link into National Trust assets and coastal routes.

 

```{r}
gpx_vars <- dict |>
  filter(dataset_id == "custom_gpx") |>
  select(`Variable` = variable_name, `Type` = data_type, `Description` = description, `Values / Units` = allowed_values_or_units, `Notes` = notes)

knitr::kable(gpx_vars, caption = "Table 3: Custom Client GPX Re-alignments Variable Dictionary")
```

 

### OS OpenRoads (Corridor Network)

 

Ordnance Survey OpenData highway network used to map road centrelines, evaluate quiet lane connectivity, and identify roads designated for HS2 construction logistics.

 

```{r}
openroads_vars <- dict |>
  filter(dataset_id == "openroads") |>
  select(`Variable` = variable_name, `Type` = data_type, `Description` = description, `Values / Units` = allowed_values_or_units, `Notes` = notes)

knitr::kable(openroads_vars, caption = "Table 4: OS OpenRoads Variable Dictionary")
```

 

### DfT STATS19 Road Safety & Collisions

 

Official Department for Transport personal injury road collisions spatially filtered within the standardized 5 km RailActive study area buffer to assess baseline traffic danger and economic appraisal safety benefits.

 

```{r}
stats19_vars <- dict |>
  filter(dataset_id == "stats19") |>
  select(`Variable` = variable_name, `Type` = data_type, `Description` = description, `Values / Units` = allowed_values_or_units, `Notes` = notes)

knitr::kable(stats19_vars, caption = "Table 5: DfT STATS19 Collisions Variable Dictionary")
```

 

### OpenStreetMap (OSM) Active Travel Infrastructure

 

Crowdsourced active travel network extracts providing detailed attributes for off-carriageway cycleways, public bridleways, pedestrian crossings, and surface conditions.

 

```{r}
osm_vars <- dict |>
  filter(dataset_id == "osm") |>
  select(`Variable` = variable_name, `Type` = data_type, `Description` = description, `Values / Units` = allowed_values_or_units, `Notes` = notes)

knitr::kable(osm_vars, caption = "Table 6: OpenStreetMap Active Travel Infrastructure Variable Dictionary")
```

 

### National Cycle Network (NCN)

 

Authoritative Sustrans National Cycle Network links, route numbers, operational open status, and infrastructure quality audits across the corridor geography.

 

```{r}
ncn_vars <- dict |>
  filter(dataset_id == "ncn") |>
  select(`Variable` = variable_name, `Type` = data_type, `Description` = description, `Values / Units` = allowed_values_or_units, `Notes` = notes)

knitr::kable(ncn_vars, caption = "Table 7: National Cycle Network (NCN) Variable Dictionary")
```

## Forthcoming & TBC Datasets

 

The following candidate datasets are currently under scoping or awaiting licensing approval and data delivery:

 

- **Trip Attractors (Schools & Strategic Developments)**: Primary and secondary schools (Get Information About Schools / GIAS) and allocated residential and commercial sites within the 5 km study area to model first- and last-mile demand.

- **Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plans (LCWIPs)**: Spatial integration of adopted LCWIP networks from local transport authorities intersecting the corridor to ensure proposed HS2 infrastructure acts as a backbone for local feeder networks.

- **OS MasterMap Road Network (OSMRN / PSGA)**: Detailed carriageway widths, average traffic speeds, and vehicle access restrictions from Ordnance Survey under the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement.

- **Pavements & Footways in OS NGD**: Dedicated pedestrian pavement geometry, effective footway widths, and severance barriers from the OS National Geographic Database.

## Interactive Variable Explorer

 

Search and filter across all variables, types, and descriptions in the complete unified data dictionary:

 

```{r}
datatable(
  dict |> filter(variable_name != "TBC"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    searchHighlight = TRUE
  ),
  filter = "top",
  rownames = FALSE
)
```
